name: Tanga

queries.query: Tanga Tanzania cadastral parcel map official land registry GIS
queries.result: Found the Ministry of Lands official e-Ardhi viewer and its public GeoServer WFS. The service exposes Tanga-area spatial-unit layers and returned bounded parcel geometries anonymously.

queries.query: ramani ya cadastral Tanga Tanzania kiwanja ardhi tovuti rasmi
queries.result: Wizara ya Ardhi inaelekeza watumiaji kwenye mfumo wa e-Ardhi; huduma ya GeoServer ya umma ilionyesha tabaka za spatial units zenye jiometri katika eneo la Tanga. Hakuna huduma tofauti ya manispaa iliyothibitishwa.

officialSources.operator: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Human Settlements Development
officialSources.evidence: First-party ministry site links directly to e-Ardhi and identifies the ministry's surveying, mapping, land administration, and title-registration functions.
Current public JavaScript configuration identifies the official GeoServer endpoint https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/map/geoserver/taspro.
First-party local-government page confirms the Tanga City Council site and Tanga local administrative context; it did not expose a separate parcel API.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET via curl with verified TLS
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Public Angular viewer HTML retrieved. It loaded main.js, whose current configuration was inspected for the public map service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET via curl with verified TLS
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Current configuration identified SERVER_URL https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/gw, GRAPHQL_API https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/api, and GEOSERVER_API https://eardhi.lands.go.tz/map/geoserver/taspro. No login or credentials were used.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET via curl with verified TLS
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Anonymous WFS capabilities returned. Advertised EPSG:4326 for tp_spatial_units, current_tp_spatial_units, and qualified_spatial_units, plus GeoJSON output. Capabilities listed a Tanga-area extent for several layers, but extents are layer-level and not treated as complete city coverage.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET via curl with verified TLS
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Bounded anonymous GeoJSON response returned three MultiPolygon features near Tanga. Native properties included numeric id, uid, parcel_id, parcel_no, block_number, locality, and other source fields; only id and geometry are eligible for retention.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET via curl with verified TLS
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Bounded anonymous GeoJSON response returned three current town-plan MultiPolygon features near Tanga, with the same native numeric id plus uid and parcel fields. No unsafe fields were retained.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET via curl with verified TLS
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Bounded anonymous GeoJSON response returned three qualified MultiPolygon features near Tanga. The layer includes native numeric id and geometry in EPSG:4326; raw response was kept only in ignored scratch space.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET via curl with verified TLS
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Request did not complete within the bounded 30-second timeout; this is not evidence of absence.

fieldMapping.native identity: properties.id (numeric native database identity); uid and parcel fields were observed but not retained

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: e-Ardhi is a national Ministry of Lands system; the WFS contains spatial-unit and town-plan layers.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous bounded WFS responses returned parcel geometries within the tested Tanga bbox. Citywide completeness, update cadence, and all Tanga neighborhoods were not verified.
coverageAssessment.targetPointHitInterpretation: The bounded response demonstrated nearby Tanga parcel coverage but did not establish an exact-point hit. Exact-point absence or a missed map extent would not prove citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: The official national map service is real and returns Tanga parcel geometry, but a serial reviewer must independently qualify adapter semantics, citywide coverage, stable identity behavior, and acceptable request limits before admission.
